about_the_game:
■Synopsis

The night before the final battle—-

The HERO Allen is on the verge of facing the Demon King, was spending his last night at an inn.

“The chance of standing is but fifty percent… If I fail…I will die…

Without knowing any women…”

Mireille his fellowship is a half-elf with a large boob dressed in provocative attire.

Allen plans to give Mireille a hypnosis potion… and commit naughty things… !

■Light short RPG

This game is a light adults-only (18+) RPG with a playtime of approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour.

There are no battles and the game emphasizes practicality and story.

■Enjoy conversations with NPCs!

You will be enjoying the conversations with NPCs at the inn.

This will deepen your understanding of the characters’ backgrounds and the world.

■Multi-Ending for replayable 2nd and 3rd playthroughs!

After the first ending, new modes are unlocked, allowing you to try for the True End.

●You can skip the erotic scenes once viewed.

●The memory room will be unlocked once cleared.
